projects.title: EduRunda Enterprise School Management System
projects.tagline: All-in-one institutional ERP for student enrollment, attendance tracking, and academic records.
projects.description: A comprehensive web-based school management system built with PHP, MySQL, and a modern responsive frontend. Automates student registration, class allocation, teacher assignments, and administrative workflows.
projects.fullOverview: EduRunda SMS was engineered to streamline daily operations in primary and secondary schools. It replaces error-prone paper registers and fragmented spreadsheets with a centralized, multi-role portal for administrators, headteachers, instructors, and parents. Includes automated student ID generation, timetable scheduling, and emergency communication logs.
keyFeatures: Student Enrollment & Biographical Profiling with photo and guardian records
Class & Section Allocation with maximum capacity enforcement
Teacher & Staff Duty Allocation with subject assignment matrix
Role-Based Access Control (Admin, Headteacher, Teacher, Bursar, Parent)
Automated Semester Promotion & Archival of historical student records
Data export to PDF and Excel for ministry and district compliance

databaseSchema.description: Stores primary student demographics and academic status.
Defines cohorts, class streams, and responsible class masters.
Faculty directory and subject specialization tracking.

projects.title: Academix Automated Grading & Report Card Engine
projects.tagline: Automated Rwandan curriculum grade calculation, term GPA rankings, and print-ready PDF report cards.
projects.description: An academic processing module engineered to compute continuous assessments, term exam marks, weighted percentages, subject rankings, and generate professional printable report cards in seconds.
projects.fullOverview: Designed to eliminate manual calculation errors during peak end-of-term grading periods. Teachers enter quiz, midterm, and final exam marks via an intuitive spreadsheet-style interface. The system calculates standardized weighted scores, assigns letter grades, assigns class rank, and compiles headmaster remarks into official report cards ready for printing.
keyFeatures: Dynamic grade boundary configuration (A: 80-100%, B: 70-79%, C: 60-69%, etc.)
Automated weighted scoring (40% Continuous Assessment + 60% Final Exam)
Instant Class Ranking and Top Performer leaderboards
Automated behavior and conduct remark generator based on performance metrics
One-click batch PDF report card generation for entire classrooms
Parent SMS preview summary of student final standing

databaseSchema.description: Individual subject evaluations per student per academic term.
Curriculum subject catalogue and credit weight coefficients.
Compiled official term summaries ready for physical and digital dispatch.

projects.title: LearnSphere Interactive Classroom & E-Learning Portal
projects.tagline: Digital syllabus delivery, multimedia lessons, homework submission, and student quizzes.
projects.description: A modern responsive learning environment built with Vue.js and React.js to provide digital lesson plans, lecture materials, and assignment submission for secondary school students.
projects.fullOverview: Built as part of an advanced web application roadmap to extend school systems beyond physical classrooms. Students can access weekly lesson modules, download revision notes, submit digital assignments, and take timed practice quizzes with immediate score feedback.
keyFeatures: Modular lesson progress tracking with completed/current status indicators
Integrated multimedia player for instructional video tutorials
Drag-and-drop assignment upload with deadline verification
Interactive multi-choice quiz simulator with instant self-assessment
Discussion forums for student-teacher questions and clarification

projects.title: AttendTrack Pro - Daily Attendance & Gate Log
projects.tagline: Quick roll-call registration, absent student alerting, and monthly attendance percentage analytics.
projects.description: A fast, touch-friendly attendance register that enables teachers to take morning and afternoon attendance in under 60 seconds per class with automatic parent SMS notification triggers.
projects.fullOverview: Absenteeism directly impacts student academic success. AttendTrack Pro enables class teachers to mark attendance via phone, tablet, or desktop. It generates monthly attendance rate reports for school inspectors and flags students with consecutive unexcused absences.
keyFeatures: Rapid 1-tap roll call interface (Present / Late / Excused / Absent)
Daily absenteeism alerts dispatched to guardian contact numbers
Term attendance percentage calculation integrated with report cards
Medical excuse tracking with doctor certificate attachment support
School-wide daily attendance dashboard for the Headmaster

projects.title: SchoolFee Billing & Tuition Reconciliation System
projects.tagline: School fee collection, balance invoicing, installment receipts, and financial audit logs.
projects.description: A robust bursar financial portal built with PHP and MySQL to manage school tuition, feeding fees, boarding costs, and automated receipt generation.
projects.fullOverview: Simplifies bursary workflows by logging installment tuition payments, tracking pending debt balances per family, and printing stamped official payment receipts. Eliminates disputes through complete audit trails.
keyFeatures: Student tuition balance overview with payment installment histories
Automated official PDF receipt generation with unique receipt vouchers
Category breakdowns (Tuition, Meals, Uniforms, Exam Fees, Boarding)
Term financial reconciliation reports for school board auditing
Overdue fee reminder SMS and printable balance demand letters

databaseSchema.description: Term invoice obligations per enrolled student.
Individual installment ledger entries with verified reference vouchers.

projects.title: MediConnect Clinic Appointment & Patient Records
projects.tagline: Patient triage booking, doctor schedule management, and outpatient clinic logs.
projects.description: A web application developed during full-stack practice to manage health clinic appointment slots, doctor availability calendars, and outpatient records.
projects.fullOverview: Built as a modular web application exploring multi-entity relational schemas and appointment scheduling algorithms. Features patient registration, appointment status progression, and doctor schedule conflict prevention.
keyFeatures: Online appointment slot reservation with real-time slot conflict checks
Doctor roster and specialty filter
Outpatient visit triage notes and basic prescription logs
Administrative patient visit statistics

databaseSchema.description: Clinic reservations and patient appointment statuses.

projects.title: QuizMaster Timed Academic Assessment Simulator
projects.tagline: Interactive timed exam engine with question randomization and auto-evaluation.
projects.description: An assessment tool created to practice state management and algorithm execution in React.js and Vue.js. Features countdown timers, question navigation, and detailed score breakdown.
projects.fullOverview: Engineered to assist teachers with fast formative testing. Students take multiple-choice quizzes under strict countdown timers. Once submitted, the system grades answers immediately, highlights incorrect responses, and provides explanatory feedback.
keyFeatures: Configurable exam countdown timer with automatic force-submission
Question navigator showing answered, flagged, and pending items
Immediate score compilation with percentage and performance feedback
Randomized question and answer order to prevent copying

projects.title: Runda AgroMarket Cooperative Exchange
projects.tagline: Agricultural produce listing, farmer cooperative inventory, and buyer order matching.
projects.description: A database-driven community marketplace built for local farmers and cooperatives in Runda to list harvest yields, check market prices, and connect directly with local buyers.
projects.fullOverview: Developed to test end-to-end CRUD operations, search filters, and catalog indexing in PHP and MySQL. Farmers can post available harvests (beans, maize, vegetables, dairy) with current pricing and contact numbers.
keyFeatures: Produce catalog with category filters and quantity availability
Farmer vendor profile with direct WhatsApp/phone contact integration
Real-time search across crop varieties and regional cooperative zones
Simple admin dashboard for verifying active cooperative members
